wrapper_compatibility_review.limitation: Household module imports us_latest and release certification at import; no frozen-model selector. The earlier actual import rejects US2.116.0 before allow_unmanaged. No bypass or installed wrapper is used.

provenance.data_scope: Fully hypothetical inputs; no survey microdata loaded or population estimates computed

methodology.resources_full_health: household_net_income + raw marketplace_net_premium; PTC once, health government cost
methodology.resources_cash: Sum of signed non-health components, excluding health benefits and health costs
methodology.expenses: Annual rent14400, childcare0, assets0 held fixed. Rent can affect SNAP/tax rules but is not subtracted from the plotted resources. Other unspecified monetary inputs are model defaults0.
methodology.take_up: Medicaid/CHIP/ACA/SNAP/EITC and tax filing true; TANF/housing false. All citizens. Age8/12 children avoid WIC; no pregnancy/disability/ESI. Children attend K12/full-time school.
methodology.law: 2017 federal rules with existing paper pre2018 ACA reform and later state/Medicaid/CHIP model inputs;2025 frozen-model scenario. Not an exact reconstruction of every historical rule or a current-law forecast.
methodology.health_values: Fixed full-national state Medicaid totals from the paper;2017 spending values begin2020,2025 use2023. CHIP values use2023 spending/2022 enrollment. No hypothetical-axis denominator.
methodology.resolution: $100 earnings grid; every plotted point computed. Annotated status transitions refined with fresh simulations to adjacent integer-dollar earnings, not sub-dollar or statutory thresholds. Recovery brackets are first sampled recovery and preceding sample, with no interpolation.
methodology.selection: 2025 cases are main.2017 is historical hybrid appendix only. Cases selected from actual2017 pilot ages50/55/60,2025 single ages35/50 and parent sweeps; annotate largest one/three sampled negative steps. All negative steps retained without a dollar floor.
methodology.controls: Fresh scalar comparisons include grid endpoints/midpoints, annotation brackets/1k/5k endpoints/recovery brackets; repeat full axes and zero-change scalar; independently constructed reform-system control; component identities and fixed national Medicaid values at every curve point.
